backtest.disclaimer: A screen, not a success-probability model. The conversion sample is small and selection-biased (only pitchers teams chose to convert), so the weights are frozen priors from the literature. The gated evaluation (per-direction rho vs same-event baselines, bootstrap CI) lives in tools/pal_backtest_lab.py -> data/pal_eval.json; the rhos here are the live stamp of the same repaired harness. Held labels read closed >=20 IP follow-up seasons only.
